bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Restores the calls the file carries; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Put the open read back on its file's own calls.

description: Put an open Sanger read back on the base calls its FILE carries, undoing an adopted re-call. The same carry runs in the other direction, so the trim window, the hand-corrected calls and the annotations come back with it rather than being left on indices the file does not have. Not the same as clearing the read's edits, which also discards the trim and the manual calls.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: restore_trace_file_calls

bases.description: how many bases the file's own reading carries

sequence.description: the read the document now carries
